# Resource: tfe_team_token

Generates a new team token. If no description is provided, it follows the legacy behavior to override the existing, descriptionless token if one exists.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    const tfeTeamTest = new tfe.team.Team(this, "test", {
      name: "my-team-name",
      organization: "my-org-name",
    });
    new tfe.teamToken.TeamToken(this, "ci", {
      description: "my second team token",
      teamId: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeTeamTest.id),
    });
    const tfeTeamTokenTest = new tfe.teamToken.TeamToken(this, "test_2", {
      description: "my team token",
      teamId: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeTeamTest.id),
    });
    /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
    tfeTeamTokenTest.overrideLogicalId("test");
  }
}

```

    const tfeTeamTokenTest = new tfe.teamToken.TeamToken(this, "test_2", {
      description: "my team token",

## Schema

### Required

- `teamId` (String) ID of the team.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the token, which must be unique per team.
- `expiredAt` (String) The token's expiration date. The expiration date must be a date/time string in RFC3339 format (e.g., "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"). If no expiration date is supplied, the token will expire 24 months from creation and a warning during plan and apply phases will be displayed.
- `forceRegenerate` (Boolean) Only applies to legacy tokens without descriptions. If set to `true`, a new token will be generated even if a token already exists. This will invalidate the existing token! Regeneration is triggered only when this value changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the team token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The generated token.



## Import

Resource tfe_team_token can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <TOKEN ID>
terraform import tfe_team_token.test at-47qC3LmA47piVan7

# via <TEAM ID>
terraform import tfe_team_token.test team-47qC3LmA47piVan7
```
